name: Seated Long Arc Quad
steps: Sit tall on a sturdy chair or examination table with your back supported and your knees bent at 90 degrees.
Rest your hands comfortably on your thighs or grip the sides of the seat for stability.
Slowly lift your target foot and straighten your leg out in front of you until your knee is fully extended and parallel to the floor.
Flex your ankle toward your shin and squeeze your quadriceps firmly at the top for 2 to 3 seconds.
Slowly lower your foot back down under control until it gently touches the floor.
coaching_cues: Maintain an upright posture and avoid slouching or leaning back as your leg straightens.
Move smoothly without kicking or swinging using momentum.
Control the downward lowering phase over 2 full seconds.
